literal_meaning: পেটে আঘাত করা (striking or hitting in the stomach)
figurative_meaning_en: To weaken and destroy through starvation
example_sentences_in_bangla: শত্রুদের পেটে মেরে তাদের পরাজিত করা হয়েছে।
দুর্ভিক্ষে গ্রামের লোকজনকে পেটে মারা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The enemies were weakened and destroyed by starving them.
The villagers were ruined through hunger during the famine.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali expressions related to survival and hardship, with 'ভাতে মারা' as a close synonym emphasizing rice deprivation.
